title: CHW secondary pumps — sequence of operations
note: PRD-SETPOINT-SIM P3. Curated; thresholds resolved by tools/build-sequences.mjs (see chiller.json).

basis.ref: ASHRAE Guideline 36-2021, chilled-water plant sequences (developed under ASHRAE RP-1711)
basis.use: the structure: variable-speed secondary pumps hold a differential-pressure setpoint, lead/lag staging on flow, standby start on a trip
basis.limits: the numbers come from this plant's engine and control registry, not from the guideline

plant: variable-speed secondary pumps on one header, duty pumps sharing the plant flow equally plus one standby per header (js/conv-engine.js hydronic fleet)

modes.label: Normal — DP control

entry.text: secondary loop enabled and every duty pump proven

actions: run the fewest pumps that carry the flow at their design flow: n = ceil(flow / unit design flow), the engine's own rule
the pump speed (VSD) holds the header differential pressure at its setpoint
rotate the lead pump by run hours

exit.text: flow above the running pumps' design flow
one fewer pump would carry the flow
header DP below its setpoint with every duty pump at full speed

assumed.value 90: 10 % hysteresis below the design flow so a stage-down does not stage straight back up; no source in this repo states it
assumed.delay_s 600: 10 min pump staging delay against short-cycling; no source in this repo states it
assumed.delay_s 120: 2 min confirmation of a low header DP; no source in this repo states it

modes.label: Stage up — start the next pump

entry.text: from Normal (flow above design) or from a trip or a low DP (at once)

actions: start the lag pump with the fewest run hours
ramp it to the speed of the running pumps
prove it running (flow or DP switch)

exit.event: the new pump is proven running

modes.label: Stage down — stop one pump

entry.text: from Normal when one fewer pump carries the flow

actions: ramp the lag pump down and stop it
the remaining pumps speed up to hold the DP setpoint

modes.label: Pump trip — standby start

entry.event: a running pump trips (VSD fault or motor protection)

actions: lock out the tripped pump and raise an alarm
start the standby pump at once (no staging delay)
the remaining pumps run to full speed; header DP falls below its setpoint while flow is short

modes.label: Low header DP — start the standby

entry.text: header DP below its setpoint with every duty pump at full speed
